$description: GenieKreator's type and shape in the canvas look (D236). src/author/author.css folds the author's weight and radius steps onto these inside .il-genie, so its classes keep their names.

strong.$description: Where the author's classes say 700 or 800: Geist reads heavier than Manrope did, and the canvas sets its emphasis at 600

card.$description: Cards, panels and dialogs (the author's 14px and up): square, as the canvas's cards

control.$description: Buttons, fields, segments, rows and insets (the author's 6px to 12px): the canvas's 4px controls

pill.$description: Chips, badges, bars and switches the author drew as pills
